page_shape.entry: Career Site Builder posting page (employer domain, /job/<slug>/<id>/) with <a> 'Apply now »' href /talentcommunity/apply/<id>/?locale=xx_XX; a cookie-consent banner ('Accept All Cookies') overlays first. The link redirects to the SF Recruiting host (careerN.successfactors.eu | careerN.sapsf.eu | careerN.successfactors.com) /careers?company=<tenant>.
page_shape.variant_A_combined: (sf-02) Single page titled 'Career Opportunities: <job> (<req id>)' with form#careerform POST: 'Already a registered user? Please sign in' link; Resume / CV (required, 'Upload a Resume' opens a dialog) + Cover Letter (optional dialog); account fields (email, retype email, password, retype password with policy text); name; phone (country code select + number); profile fields (preferred name, home phone, country picklist, address lines, city, state picklist, zip); VOLUNTARY PRE-EMPLOYMENT INFORMATION (Hispanic/Latino, ethnicity, gender, veteran); APPLICATION QUESTIONS (employer custom); Country/Region of Residence select; notification checkboxes (pre-checked ON); Terms of Use 'Read and accept the data privacy statement' required link; single 'Apply' submit.
page_shape.variant_B_signin_first: (sf-03) 'Career Opportunities: Sign In' page (Email/Password/Sign In, 'Forgot your password?', 'Create an account') -> 'Career Opportunities: Create an Account' (email x2, password x2, first/last name, country of residence, 2 notification checkboxes unchecked, 'Create Account'). Questions only after account.
page_shape.captcha: sf-02: an input#recaptcha_response_field_signin_modal exists inside the hidden sign-in modal only; no captcha on the apply form itself. sf-03: none.

control_families.account_text: input[name=fbclc_userName|fbclc_emailConf] maxlength 99; input[type=password][name=fbclc_pwd|fbclc_pwdConf] with aria-describedby policy text (14–18 chars at Bausch; 8–18 at Hexagon); label text 'Email Address: *' etc. (colon + space + asterisk).
control_families.profile_text: input[name^=tor__f…] maxlength 100 with <label>; e.g. tor__fpreferredName, tor__faddress, tor__fcity, tor__fzip, tor__fsalaryExpect
control_families.paginated_picklist: input#<n>:_input.paginatedPicklistContainer with aria-label = question, aria-owns '<n+1>:_listSelect'. Options are NOT in the DOM until the input is clicked/focused; then a listbox of li/option appears with 'No Selection' first. Dependent picklists (ethnicity after Hispanic, Source after 'how did you hear', State after Country) stay closed/disabled until the parent has a value. Required = aria-required=true.
control_families.file: 'Upload a Resume' / 'Attach a Cover Letter' buttons open a dialog; no input[type=file] in the base DOM. Accepted: DOCX, PDF, Image and Text (MSG, PPT, XLS rejected).
control_families.checkbox: input[type=checkbox][name=fbclc_emailEnabled|fbclc_campaignEmailEnabled] (marketing/notification; pre-checked on Bausch, unchecked on Hexagon)
control_families.consent_link: a#dataPrivacyId 'Read and accept the data privacy statement.' aria-label ends 'Required' — opens a statement dialog that must be accepted before Apply
control_families.submit: button[type=submit]#fbqa_apply text 'Apply' (variant A) — creates the account AND submits the application in one action

runtime_observations: Always enter via the posting page's Apply link; accept the cookie banner first or the click may be intercepted.
Picklist reading: focus+click input#<n>:_input, wait ~2s, read li/option under aria-owns target, Escape. Verify aria-expanded=true; a closed dependent list yields stale text from other lists.
Labels come from aria-label on the picklist input and <label> for tor__f* fields; required is aria-required or trailing '*'.
Resume upload only via dialog button, not a direct file input.

inferred.confidence: medium: one full form; custom APPLICATION QUESTIONS block is employer-specific; Career Site Builder + SF Recruiting layout is standard across tenants

provider_hint.for_jev: SuccessFactors: after cookie banner and Apply link, either (A) one long page that creates an account (email x2, password x2) AND asks the application: required resume via dialog, name, phone with country code, full address, voluntary EEO picklists (some tenants mark Gender/Veteran/Ethnicity required), custom yes/no picklists on work authorization, permanent right to work, sponsorship, relatives at company, former employment, confidentiality and non-compete agreements, plus free-text follow-ups, salary expectations with currency, an e-signature Full Name, marketing opt-ins pre-checked, and a required data-privacy acceptance; or (B) sign-in/create-account first with questions hidden. Runtime must stop before account creation/Apply.
